title: Checks for expressions that could be replaced by the ? operator.
summary: Using the ? operator is shorter and more idiomatic. Clippy puts this lint in the style group, at the level warn.

title: Checks for expressions that use the ? operator and rejects them.
summary: Sometimes code wants to avoid the ? operator because for instance a local block requires a macro to re-throw errors to attach additional information to the error. Clippy puts this lint in the restriction group, at the level allow.
